mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_portal_attachment ( portal_id, gmt_create, gmt_modify, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, file_ext, stage, attachment_state, ai_text) VALUES ( #{portalId}, now(), now(), #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{fileExt}, #{stage}, #{attachmentState}, #{aiText});
mapper.select: SELECT id, portal_id AS portalId, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, file_name AS fileName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, file_ext AS fileExt, stage, attachment_state AS attachmentState, ai_text AS aiText FROM b_portal_attachment WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER};

SELECT id, portal_id AS portalId, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, file_name AS fileName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, file_ext AS fileExt, stage, attachment_state AS attachmentState, ai_text AS aiText FROM b_portal_attachment WHERE file_path = #{filePath};

SELECT id, portal_id AS portalId, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, file_name AS fileName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, file_ext AS fileExt, stage, attachment_state AS attachmentState, ai_text AS aiText FROM b_portal_attachment WHERE portal_id = #{portalId} ORDER BY gmt_create ASC, id ASC;
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM b_portal_attachment WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER}
